model.about: Mistral AI Ministral 3 14B Instruct (2512) in BF16, as published by Mistral: the same model as ministral-3-14b without FP8, for the A100, which has no FP8 hardware and on whose generation (an A40) the FP8 version failed to compile. Apache-2.0. Same settings as the FP8 profile: vLLM v0.29.0 (v0.30.0 cannot load Mistral 3, vllm-project/vllm#58755), Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none, temperature 0.05.

WITH business_dates_2025 AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)

SELECT
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    dchnl.BUS_CD1 AS channel_code,
    COUNT(faccttxn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN faccttxn
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CHNL dchnl ON faccttxn.CHNL_K = dchnl.CHNL_K
JOIN
    business_dates_2025 bd ON faccttxn.BUS_DT_K = bd.DT_K
GROUP BY
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM, dchnl.BUS_CD1
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH aml_alerts_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        jur.JUR_K,
        jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
        COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON f.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        jur.JUR_K, jur.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM aml_alerts_2025;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f.BR_K,
        d.BUS_ID,
        d.DSPLY_NM
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND d.IS_ACTV = TRUE
)
SELECT
    BUS_ID,
    DSPLY_NM,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    atm_txn_2025
GROUP BY
    BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EVNT_ID) AS total_card_disputes_2025 FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_CD_DSPT.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM D_DT.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID) AS number_of_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'

SELECT 
    d.BUS_ID,
    d.DSPLY_NM,
    COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    dccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    dccy.DSPLY_NM AS currency_name,
    AVG(ffxrt.MID_RT) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D ffxrt
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY dccy ON ffxrt.CCY_K = dccy.CCY_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON ffxrt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ddt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY
    dccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, dccy.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY
    dccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
    AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH atm_txn_q1_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        atm.BR_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.QTR_NBR = 1
        AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(atm_txn_q1_2025.BR_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    atm_txn_q1_2025
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm_txn_q1_2025.BR_K = br.BR_K
GROUP BY
    br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(f_fx_rt.MID_RT) AS average_mid_rate
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_fx_rt.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_fx_rt.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE
    d_ccy.BUS_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31';

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_disputes
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fcd_dsp
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fcd_dsp.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY 
    d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY 
    d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM 
    bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE 
    IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC;

WITH customers_with_transactions_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON txn.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_no_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT BUS_ID FROM customers_with_transactions_2025
  );

WITH card_auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_authorizations
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE
        bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),

declined_authorizations AS (

        bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K

        bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED'
)

SELECT
    (declined_count * 100.0 / total_authorizations) AS declined_percentage

WITH escalated_complaints_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
    complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM
    escalated_complaints_2025
GROUP BY
    complaint_category_name;

WITH fee_amounts_2025 AS (
    -- Fees from account fee table
    SELECT
        dchnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
        COALESCE(facct.FEE_AMT, 0) AS fee_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE facct
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CHNL dchnl ON facct.CHNL_K = dchnl.CHNL_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON facct.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ddt.CAL_DT) = 2025
        AND dchnl.IS_CURR = TRUE
    UNION ALL
    -- Fees from account transaction table
    SELECT
        dchnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
        COALESCE(factxn.FEE_AMT, 0) AS fee_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN factxn
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CHNL dchnl ON factxn.CHNL_K = dchnl.CHNL_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON factxn.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ddt.CAL_DT) = 2025
        AND dchnl.IS_CURR = TRUE
)

SELECT
    channel_name,
    SUM(fee_amount) AS total_fees_2025
FROM
    fee_amounts_2025
GROUP BY
    channel_name
ORDER BY
    total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT 
    SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
WHERE 
    DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS high_severity_aml_alerts_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND a.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
WHERE bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH mobile_app_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS transaction_year,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        chnl.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
        AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT * FROM mobile_app_transactions;

WITH dec_2025_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        f.LN_PRD_K,
        f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        d.DSPLY_NM
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT
    d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM
    dec_2025_snapshots f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
GROUP BY
    d.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON wr.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE wr.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f_atm_txn.BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f_atm_txn
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_atm_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f_atm_txn.BR_K
),

branch_region_txn AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.BR_K,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        atm.txn_count
    FROM
        atm_txn_2025 atm
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
),

ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rank_in_region
    FROM
        branch_region_txn
)

SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    txn_count
FROM
    ranked_branches
WHERE
    rank_in_region = 1;

WITH merchant_category_auth_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        m.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
        SUM(fca.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fca
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON fca.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fca.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
)
SELECT
    MRCH_CTG_CD1,
    total_amount
FROM
    merchant_category_auth_amounts
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH customer_wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        cust.BUS_ID,
        SUM(wr.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON wr.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        cust.BUS_ID
)
SELECT
    BUS_ID,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
    customer_wire_transfers_2025
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        f.ORGNL_AMT AS amount,
        d.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS iso_alpha_code
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY d ON f.CCY_K = d.CCY_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    SUM(amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
    wire_transfers_2025
GROUP BY
    iso_alpha_code;

WITH wire_transfer_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON ft.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ), atm_transaction_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON fat.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers_both_transactions FROM ( SELECT BUS_ID FROM wire_transfer_customers_2025 INTERSECT SELECT BUS_ID FROM atm_transaction_customers_2025 ) c;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE D_DT.DT_K = F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K)) = 2025;

WITH wire_transfers_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr_trf
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT * FROM wire_transfers_by_year;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        CUST_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE
        IS_CURR = TRUE
),

deposit_balances AS (
    SELECT
        cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
        SUM(fd.AVRG_BAL_AMT) AS total_avg_deposit_balance
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_DEP_BAL_D fd
    JOIN
        current_customers cc ON fd.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
    GROUP BY
        cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
),

loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
        SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_loan_principal
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
    JOIN
        current_customers cc ON fb.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
    GROUP BY
        cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(db.segment, lb.segment) AS segment,
    COALESCE(db.total_avg_deposit_balance, 0) AS avg_deposit_balance,
    COALESCE(lb.total_outstanding_loan_principal, 0) AS total_loan_principal,
    (COALESCE(db.total_avg_deposit_balance, 0) + COALESCE(lb.total_outstanding_loan_principal, 0)) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM
    deposit_balances db
FULL OUTER JOIN
    loan_balances lb ON db.segment = lb.segment
ORDER BY
    segment;

-- List of branch names
WITH fact_aml_alert_truncated AS (
    SELECT 'fact_aml_alert truncated' AS message
)
SELECT 
    DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM 
    bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE 
    IS_CURR = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    message
FROM 
    fact_aml_alert_truncated;

WITH wire_transfer_volume AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS iso_currency_code,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
)
SELECT
    iso_currency_code AS currency,
    total_volume
FROM
    wire_transfer_volume
ORDER BY
    total_volume DESC;

SELECT 
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    dchnl.BUS_CD1 AS channel_code,
    COUNT(faccttxn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN faccttxn
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CHNL dchnl ON faccttxn.CHNL_K = dchnl.CHNL_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON faccttxn.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ddt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM, dchnl.BUS_CD1
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH aml_alerts_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        jur.JUR_K,
        jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
        COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON f.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        jur.JUR_K, jur.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM aml_alerts_2025;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f.BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.BR_K
)

SELECT
    b.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COALESCE(atm.transaction_count, 0) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.D_BR b
LEFT JOIN
    atm_txn_2025 atm ON b.BR_K = atm.BR_K
WHERE
    b.IS_ACTV = TRUE
ORDER BY
    atm.transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_card_disputes_2025 FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd WHERE fd.BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT d.DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

WITH latest_august_2025_delinquency AS (
    SELECT
        fld.DFLT_FLG,
        fld.CUST_K,
        fld.BUS_DT_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fld
    WHERE
        fld.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
        AND fld.BUS_DT_K = (
            SELECT MAX(bd.DT_K)
            FROM bank_dwh.D_DT bd
            WHERE bd.CALENDAR_DT >= '2025-08-01'
              AND bd.CALENDAR_DT <= '2025-08-31'
        )
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.BUS_ID) AS number_of_clients_in_default
FROM
    latest_august_2025_delinquency ld
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON ld.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K;

SELECT 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS complaint_year,
    dcc.BUS_ID AS complaint_category_business_id,
    dcc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(fc.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM

    iso_alpha_code,
    AVG(mid_rate) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM
    fx_rates_2025
GROUP BY
    currency_code, iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY
    currency_code;

WITH accounts_opened_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        ACCT_TYP_CD1
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_ACCT
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
        AND IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM
    accounts_opened_2025
GROUP BY
    ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY
    ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS city,
    COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY
    br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_transaction_count DESC;

WITH valid_accounts_on_30june2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.ACCT_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
    WHERE
        a.IS_ACTV = TRUE
        AND a.EFF_FRM_DT <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (a.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR a.EFF_TO_DT >= '2025-06-30')
        AND a.IS_CURR = TRUE
),

date_key_for_30june2025 AS (
    SELECT
        DT_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE
        CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN
    valid_accounts_on_30june2025 a ON f.ACCT_K = a.ACCT_K
JOIN
    date_key_for_30june2025 d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
    f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    AVG(fx_rt_d.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx_rt_d
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx_rt_d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE 
    fx_rt_d.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31';

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(f.CD_DSPT_F_K) AS dispute_count
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY 
    d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY 
    month_number;

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM 
    bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE 
    IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC;

WITH customers_with_transactions_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
customer_ids_with_transactions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM customers_with_transactions_2025) AND IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_transactions_2025
FROM all_customers
LEFT JOIN customer_ids_with_transactions ON all_customers.BUS_ID = customer_ids_with_transactions.BUS_ID
WHERE customer_ids_with_transactions.BUS_ID IS NULL;

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f.*
    FROM 
        bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
    JOIN 
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM 
    auth_2025;

WITH escalated_complaints_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        c.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        c.IS_ESCLT,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON c.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        c.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
        AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM
    escalated_complaints_2025
GROUP BY
    complaint_category_name
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
WHERE 
    DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS high_severity_aml_alerts_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND a.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
WHERE bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE 
    (chnl.DSPLY_NM LIKE '%Mobile%' OR chnl.CHNL_TYP_CD1 LIKE '%Mobile%' 
     OR chnl.DSC LIKE '%Mobile%' OR chnl.BUS_CD1 LIKE '%Mobile%')
    AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH latest_daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        f.LN_PRD_K,
        f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        d.DSPLY_NM,
        f.BUS_DT_K,
        dt.CAL_DT AS BUS_DT
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT
    DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM
    latest_daily_balances
GROUP BY
    DSPLY_NM;

WITH cross_border_wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f.CUST_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
        AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_transfers
FROM
    bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN
    cross_border_wire_transfers_2025 w ON c.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
WHERE
    c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM 
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
    WHERE 
        -- Filter for 2025 by extracting the year from BUS_DT_K (YYYYMMDD format)
        TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS VARCHAR), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY') = '2025'
    GROUP BY 
        BR_K
),

ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        atm.txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY atm.txn_count DESC) AS rank_in_region
    FROM 
        atm_txn_2025 atm
    JOIN 
        bank_dwh.D_BR b ON atm.BR_K = b.BR_K AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
)

SELECT 
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    txn_count AS atm_transaction_count
FROM 
    ranked_branches
WHERE 
    rank_in_region = 1;

WITH merchant_category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        m.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
)
SELECT
    MRCH_CTG_CD1,
    total_amount
FROM
    merchant_category_totals
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    d.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K AND d.IS_CURR = true
WHERE
    f.BUS_DT_K IN (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    )
GROUP BY
    d.BUS_ID
ORDER BY
    TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMOUNT DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        f.ORGNL_AMT AS amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(w.amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
    wire_transfers_2025 w
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON w.currency_code = c.BUS_CD1
GROUP BY
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

WITH wire_transfer_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON ft.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ), atm_transaction_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON fat.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers_both_transactions FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.BUS_ID IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM wire_transfer_customers_2025) AND c.BUS_ID IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM atm_transaction_customers_2025);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE D_DT.DT_K = F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K)) = 2025;

WITH wire_transfers_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS transfer_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY
        d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
    year,
    transfer_count
FROM
    wire_transfers_by_year
ORDER BY
    year;

WITH
-- Customers with declining transaction activity
customers_with_low_activity AS (
    SELECT
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(f.NET_AMT) AS total_net_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f ON c.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
        AND f.BUS_DT_K IN (
            SELECT BUS_DT_K
            FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
            ORDER BY BUS_DT_K DESC
            LIMIT 3  -- Most recent 3 months
        )
    WHERE
        c.IS_CURR = TRUE
        AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.BUS_ID
    ORDER BY
        transaction_count ASC, total_net_amount ASC
    LIMIT 100
),

-- Customers with negative interactions
customers_with_negative_interactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_INTRC_F_K) AS interaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.STSFC_SCR_VAL1 < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_satisfaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS escalation_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_REG_CMPLT = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS regulatory_complaint_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC f ON c.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
        AND f.BUS_DT_K IN (
            SELECT BUS_DT_K
            FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC
            ORDER BY BUS_DT_K DESC
            LIMIT 3  -- Most recent 3 months
        )
    WHERE
        c.IS_CURR = TRUE
        AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.BUS_ID
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_INTRC_F_K) > 0
        OR SUM(CASE WHEN f.STSFC_SCR_VAL1 < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
        OR SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
        OR SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_REG_CMPLT = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)

-- Combine results to identify high-risk customers
SELECT
    COALESCE(lac.customer_business_id, ni.customer_business_id) AS customer_business_id,
    lac.transaction_count,
    lac.total_net_amount,
    ni.interaction_count,
    ni.low_satisfaction_count,
    ni.escalation_count,
    ni.regulatory_complaint_count,
    CASE
        WHEN lac.customer_business_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Declining Activity'
        WHEN ni.customer_business_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Negative Interactions'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS risk_indicator
FROM
    customers_with_low_activity lac
FULL OUTER JOIN
    customers_with_negative_interactions ni ON lac.customer_business_id = ni.customer_business_id
WHERE
    lac.customer_business_id IS NOT NULL
    OR ni.customer_business_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN lac.customer_business_id IS NOT NULL THEN lac.transaction_count
        ELSE ni.interaction_count
    END ASC
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_lifetime_value AS (
    SELECT
        c.BUS_ID,
        SUM(f.NET_AMT) AS total_lifetime_value
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE
        c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.BUS_ID
)

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT clv.BUS_ID) AS customer_count,
    AVG(clv.total_lifetime_value) AS avg_lifetime_value
FROM
    customer_lifetime_value clv
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON clv.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY
    avg_lifetime_value DESC;
